structureQa.scope: Five accepted Project 007 experiment pairs only; smoke baseline, not a cross-model benchmark.

claimsBoundary: The upstream examples demonstrate the visual language claimed by the upstream README, not repeatability or cross-model performance.
The five Project 007 experiments demonstrate five successful small-sample runs, not a benchmark or success rate.
The three Chinese-text experiments rendered the requested copy exactly in these observed outputs; this is not a general Chinese-text accuracy rate.
The three same-source emotion variants follow user-specified directions and exact copy; they do not infer, classify or diagnose emotion.
The fluorescent-figure demonstration is one successful targeted edit and does not prove pixel-local figure isolation.
The music cover, diary card and social post are deterministic HTML/CSS assemblies, not additional image-model outputs.
Semantic composition locking reduced visible drift in these examples but is not pixel-level geometry control.
The runtime web simulator compiles text only and does not invoke an image model.
